name: market_s4_ctce_batch
description: CTCE (entropy 0.01 / 13, clip 0.2) with four times the batch per update: 2000 environment steps, minibatches of 256, 10 epochs. The clip (market_s4_ctce) and a larger network (market_s4_ctce_net) did not raise CTCE's held-out return; what is left is the noise of one team advantage for 13 agents, which a larger batch averages down.
